capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Nexuses, the person's role, TAG invited, expectation summary.

capabilities.name: tag.work.status
capabilities.use: State and outcome of TAG work.

capabilities.name: tag.request.ask
capabilities.use: File a confirmed request for TAG's side.

capabilities.name: aletia.nexus.read
capabilities.use: Parties, people, role and lenses of a nexus.

capabilities.name: aletia.lens.read
capabilities.use: Expectations with their documents, by status or gaps.

capabilities.name: aletia.people.read
capabilities.use: Recipients the person can send to.

capabilities.name: aletia.sends.read
capabilities.use: Documents sent and requests asked by name.

capabilities.name: aletia.supply.write
capabilities.use: File or send a document the person provides, after confirmation.

inputs.name: the signed-in person and their nexuses
inputs.source: the client's OAuth sign-in through the TAG login; tag.context.overview

inputs.name: documents to file or send
inputs.source: files the person attaches or a drive connected in their client

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: Facts with record identifiers and states as the tools report them.

outputs.name: confirmed write
outputs.description: The confirmed request or send and the identifier returned.

outputs.name: draft
outputs.description: Back-office work done for the organization (a close step, a reconciliation, a journal entry, a statement, a contract review), marked as a draft for the person to check.

conditions: The person confirms the exact text, recipient and nexus before tag.request.ask or aletia.supply.write is called.
Access is aletia's decision on every call; the skill never filters, grants or works around a refusal.
